promptText:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI desktop app redesign concept
Input image role: the visible source screenshot is a reference image for layout, state, and information architecture, not an edit target that must be pixel-preserved.
Primary request: Redesign 04-B-01-home-dashboard/default as a calm TOPIK study dashboard.
Direction: quiet command center.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 screenshot, fixed left sidebar, compact KPI row, recommendation cards, recent feedback, quick start, exam and notification panels. Preserve the dashboard state and core page purpose.
Style/medium: high-fidelity web UI mockup, Ant Design-friendly layout, compact operational study workspace.
Color palette: Mist #f4f4f5 canvas, Snow #ffffff cards, Fog #ececee secondary surfaces, Ink/Obsidian text, Obsidian #09090b primary CTA only.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans font, compact density, weight-driven hierarchy, no letter spacing.
Constraints: workspace panels should use restrained 4-8px radii; one clear primary action per task area; color signals must be paired with text or icons; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: loud AI gradients, purple/blue SaaS glow, chromatic repeated CTAs, oversized soft bubbles, heavy card shadows, decorative orbs, watermark, raw implementation/debug text.
negativeConstraints: no distorted Korean text as final copy
